properties.name: fastddd.security.audit.result-judging.enabled
properties.description: Whether @AuditLog judges success from the returned ApiResponse envelope (direct return or one-layer ResponseEntity wrapper; code != 200 records success=false and carries the envelope message into error_message). Set false to restore 1.0.0 always-success semantics. Exact key literal (kebab-case) — @Value has no relaxed binding.
